purpose: Test whether controlling from the likelihood of the token actually selected, rather than the vocabulary maximum, offers useful compression opportunities during stochastic decoding.
mechanism: Replace per-token max_j p(j|prefix) by p(sampled_token|prefix), computed from raw logits before temperature, top-p, penalties or grammar. Keep arithmetic step mean, two-step variance, existing raw vector, selected layer and curve parameters unchanged. This is a new variant of the public-code adaptation, not a paper reconstruction or a claim that the current max-probability definition is a bug.

basis.location: GPUModelRunner.sample; raw amax minus logsumexp before sampler
basis.evidence: Current confidence ignores which token stochastic sampling chooses; this is deliberate current semantics.
On greedy tokens p(selected)=max(p), so the proposed statistic preserves the original calibration definition in exact arithmetic. No new calibration answers or vector fitting are needed.

basis.derivation: Negative log probability measures surprise of the realized event; max probability only describes the modal event. For probabilities[0.6,0.4], selecting the second token gives confidence0.4 rather than0.6. This distinction does not by itself prove better reasoning.

first_stage: Replay all100 already-saved unsteered stochastic MATH training answers from the completed SEAL comparison, including8 capped answers. Use original token IDs and the identical verified prompt builder/tokenizer. No answer regeneration, no extension of capped traces, no AIME/test-set inputs, no correctness-based selection. These100 are development diagnostics and are excluded from any future candidate evaluation.
why_GPU: Their raw next-token distributions were not saved. Existing max/selected probabilities cannot be recovered from text or hidden scalar geometry alone. One teacher-forced decoder forward and chunked LM-head application recover both on each saved prefix; no sampling occurs.
replay_outputs: For each saved thinking token: raw maximum probability, raw selected-token probability, and argmax-token ID. Save input token IDs, reconstructed prompt IDs, per-question progress, runtime and input/model/source hashes. Expected probability arrays under10MB; no full logits or hidden states retained.
CPU_analysis: Apply both fixed confidence definitions to exactly the same saved prefix stream, preserving excluded delimiter/end markers and last-nonempty-step semantics. Compute both curves without fitting. Check finite0<=p<=1, selected<=max and equality whenever selected equals argmax. All capped/errors retained. Gate failure closes the candidate without changing thresholds or strength.
numerical_limits: Teacher-forced HF replay can differ numerically from vLLM incremental generation; opportunity counts are offline diagnostics, not observed online intervention counts. A candidate GPU screen would require separate short compiled checks and fresh controls.
engineering_before_replay: Local shape/index/controller checks; CPU server tokenizer/prompt reconstruction and model/source hashes before any CUDA model load. Stop on source mismatch, malformed inputs, foreign GPU job, OOM, nonfinite probabilities or timeout, preserving partials.
GPU_generation_if_gate_passes: The separate local_prepared_batch_20260912 parent plan fixes a new two-arm1.5B100-question screen,8-question short checks, and a conditional200-question independent reserve before any GPU work. Original max-probability control versus sampled-probability candidate, same16000formal cap and frozen5percent think/total, nondecreasing correctness, nonincreasing caps gate. Replay gate failure skips all candidate generation; screen failure leaves its reserve untouched. This preparation is not GPU authorization.
risks: Low-probability sampled tokens may be productive exploration rather than noise.
The alternative statistic is lower by construction and may overactivate negative steering, increasing mistakes or caps.

Two-step variance is recomputed from the new means with the same formula. It can shrink and remove the strong negative adjustment, so a lower confidence does not guarantee a more negative coefficient. A feasible temperature0.7/top_p0.95 synthetic counterexample was checked locally; the absolute-difference opportunity gate is unchanged.
The same-prefix opportunity check does not simulate future steered trajectories.
A post-sampler gather must use an unmodified copy of raw logits because the sampler mutates logits in place.
